hypothesised_pattern: Targets are higher than predicted when x2 and x5 share a sign (especially with |x4| near or above 1) and lower than predicted when x2 and x5 have opposite signs.
rationale: All eight positive-residual rows (targets 0.51-0.82) have x2*x5 > 0 (about 0.5 to 2.1) and |x4| between 0.87 and 1.73. Both negative-residual rows (targets 0.12 and 0.29) have x2*x5 < 0 (-2.378*0.732 and -1.969*0.491) and smaller |x4| (0.761, 0.445), so they match the same bilinear-plus-quadratic rule.
